topic: SaaS Security Questionnaire Evidence Pack: 7 Red Flags Before AI Answers
boundary: Educational operations guide only — not legal, compliance, medical, financial, security certification, savings, ranking, customer-result, approval, or guaranteed-performance advice.

red_flags.name: Unclear source owner
red_flags.signal: No one can point to who approved the policy, control answer, or exception note.
red_flags.safe_first_action: Assign an internal owner before drafting AI text.

red_flags.name: Copied vendor language
red_flags.signal: The answer sounds polished but does not match your actual systems, process, or evidence.
red_flags.safe_first_action: Replace generic wording with evidence-backed, company-specific facts.

red_flags.name: Missing proof link
red_flags.signal: The answer says a process exists but no policy, ticket, screenshot, log, or owner note is attached.
red_flags.safe_first_action: Keep a proof reference next to each important answer.

red_flags.name: Overstated coverage
red_flags.signal: Words like all, always, certified, guaranteed, or compliant appear without formal evidence.
red_flags.safe_first_action: Downgrade to bounded, factual language unless formally verified.

red_flags.name: Old control status
red_flags.signal: The answer was true last quarter but no one checked whether tools, vendors, or owners changed.
red_flags.safe_first_action: Add review date, current owner, and last verified evidence.

red_flags.name: No exception route
red_flags.signal: The team has no safe way to answer partially met, not applicable, or planned controls.
red_flags.safe_first_action: Use honest status labels instead of forcing a yes.

red_flags.name: Customer-risk blind spot
red_flags.signal: Sales speed is prioritized over accuracy, audit trail, or buyer trust.
red_flags.safe_first_action: Route high-risk answers for human approval before sending.

diagnostic_scope.buyer_trigger: vendor/security questionnaires take too long or answers vary by salesperson, tool, or customer
diagnostic_scope.safe_first_scope: no credentials, production access, customer data, certification claim, compliance guarantee, legal advice, or buyer approval promise
diagnostic_scope.output: answer inventory, evidence map, red-flag list, owner review queue, reusable safe-language rules, and next-decision recommendation
